newsitem.title: UK: CRUDE TANKER RATES HOLD FIRM AS IRAQ OIL LOOMS.
newsitem.headline: CRUDE TANKER RATES HOLD FIRM AS IRAQ OIL LOOMS.

text.p: Crude oil tanker charter rates held firm on Wednesday as potential customers for revived Iraqi exports jostled for position.
U.S. Coastal dominated fixture lists from Iraq's Turkish pipeline outlet of Ceyhan taking three Suezmax vessels for mid-to-late August to the U.S. Gulf at W77.5.
The company was also reported by brokers to have taken the VLCC Arcadia to replace the Concordia for mid-August.
French Elf and Spanish Repsol also figured on Thursday as early customers for Iraqi crude under the second phase of the U.N.'s humanitarian exchange.
Cross-Med Suezmax rates were quoted by brokers steady at W75 with 80,000 tonners at about W105.
Inter/UK-Cont rates jumped ten points to W97.5 for 80,000 tonnes but rates along most other routes remained stable.
VLCC rates west from the Middle East stayed at W70 and at about W87 to Japan after a surge of chartering by Saudi Aramco shipping arm Vela.
